messages:
maya: noticing p99 spikes on streamed outputs after last runtime roll. traces show partial-decode chunks that touch KV get a big latency bump when eviction runs mid-batch.

arjun: can you paste a trace or CI link?

maya: trace gist: https://internal-gists/stream-evict-2140000000
maya: perf CI: https://ci.internal/reports/streaming/2140000000

ben: looked at the flamegraph. pattern: eviction changes in-place layout -> next partial-decode picks a fallback kernel with wider memory ops -> memcpy overhead + kernel switch ~1.7-2x for those chunks.

lia: we've seen coupling before. idea: instead of global flush windows, add small per-worker phase offsets derived from recent eviction periodicity so flushes de-synchronize from KV sweeps.

arjun: so compute avg_eviction_period and pick phase_shift = (avg_period * jitter) % flush_period? what jitter range?

lia: start jitter_factor=0.12, lookback=90s. phase_shift applied to flush timer for each worker. config gated behind canary flag.

ben: complementary change: kernel selector bias for partial-decode path. if remaining_tokens < 48 and estimated_kv_locality > 0.7 prefer 'lean_decode' kernel to avoid heavy memcpy.

maya: both low-risk. perf-bot flagged p99 +7% on canary with correlation: eviction_ts and flush_ts aligned in ~80% of top traces.

perf-bot: regression details: p99 increased; correlated tag: kv_eviction_align=true. report: https://ci.internal/reports/streaming/2140000000/regression

arjun: rollout plan:
- lia: implement phase_shift, expose jitter_factor and lookback. rollout 5% traffic.
- ben: add kernel-selector flag 'lean_partial_pref' + microbench + unit tests.
- maya: add an observability tag 'flush_desynced' and a histogram flush_phase_offset vs eviction_phase_offset.

ben: patch WIP: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4720 (includes selector gate and microbench harness). will attach flamegraphs to PR.

lia: will push phase_shift config as feature-flag and schedule canary 5% tomorrow morning.

maya: also add a smoke test that simulates eviction during an active partial-decode so CI catches regressions.

arjun: if metrics don't improve after 24h, fallback plan: soft-coalescer in KV (delay final eviction for N ms if shard seen by active partial-decodes). risk: memory pressure.

ben: small code snippet for selector heuristic I plan to add:
```
// in kernel_selector
if (is_partial_decode && remaining_tokens < 48 && kv_locality_prob > 0.7 && feature_flag(lean_partial_pref)) {
  return select_kernel("lean_decode");
}
return select_best_kernel();
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled: phase_shift 5% canary @ 2024-07-18T09:00Z; kernel-flag enabled on canary path.

maya: action items recap:
- ben: finalize PR, include microbench + flamegraphs (ETA today)
- lia: deploy phase_shift to 5% and dashboard flush_vs_eviction (ETA tomorrow)
- arjun: add 'flush_desynced' metric and small smoke harness (ETA EOD)
- maya: monitor canary for 24h and decide on next steps.

lia: adding dashboard panels: flush_phase_offset histogram, eviction_phase_offset, p99 by route. will tag experiments in console.

ben: noted. I'll add deterministic microbench script that toggles eviction timing to reproduce locally.

maya: thanks team. low-risk first, kv-coalescer if necessary. :thumbsup:
